b3dt.summary: CAD: goals (ordered features: bosses, holes, pockets, revolves, patterns, fillets, lofts, sweeps, threads, text) -> build123d solids, STEP files, scripts
b3dt.cost: light (milliseconds to ~1 s per part): run it next to the Claude app

feat.summary: FEA: static, modal, buckling, steady heat (with thermal stress), DC conduction, electrostatics, Joule heating (Gmsh + CalculiX)
feat.cost: light to moderate (seconds to minutes per study)

backends.name: CalculiX (ccx)
backends.without: the reference solver runs static, modal and thermal on small meshes; no buckling

backends.name: Gmsh
backends.without: only box parts can be meshed

env.FEAT_CCX: path to the CalculiX executable (default: ccx on PATH, /opt/homebrew/bin, ...)
env.FEAT_EXECUTOR: local | slurm: long studies as SLURM jobs (docs/EXECUTION.md)
env.FEAT_SLURM_MIN_MINUTES: studies estimated shorter than this run locally

cfdt.summary: CFD: steady flow, laminar or k-omega SST, internal or external; incompressible, or with energy: compressible air to transonic, heated walls, buoyancy (OpenFOAM)
cfdt.cost: heavy (minutes to hours per study): a good candidate for a remote workstation

uses.feat: external-flow loads into FEA, chain benchmarks

tuning.why: 3 h per study: OpenFOAM runs on a workstation are long

backends.name: OpenFOAM
backends.without: meshing, case writing and the 2D reference solver only

backends.name: Gmsh
backends.without: only box domains can be meshed

env.CFDT_FOAM: OpenFOAM's etc/bashrc (or PATH if the shell already has OpenFOAM)
env.CFDT_EXECUTOR: local | slurm: long studies as SLURM jobs (docs/EXECUTION.md)
env.CFDT_SLURM_MIN_MINUTES: studies estimated shorter than this run locally

lmpt.summary: Atomistic: crystals and molecular liquids; MD, elastic constants, EOS, vacancies, surfaces, thermal expansion (LAMMPS)
lmpt.cost: moderate to heavy (seconds to hours per study): local or remote

optional_extras.lammps: LAMMPS from PyPI (wheel) instead of a system LAMMPS; needs MPI libraries, see BACKENDS.md

backends.name: LAMMPS
backends.without: nothing runs (inputs can still be written)

env.LMPT_EXECUTOR: local | slurm: long studies as SLURM jobs (docs/EXECUTION.md)
env.LMPT_SLURM_MIN_MINUTES: studies estimated shorter than this run locally
